body.cap: DongKyu Kim (center), CEO of CALIVERSE, with Leo Thevenet (left), editor of Le Café du Geek, and Kapil Kajal (right), editor of Interesting Engineering, at the Global Media Meetup held at CALIVERSE’s headquarters in Seoul. | Photo by AVING News

body.x: CALIVERSE (CEO DongKyu Kim), a global leader in metaverse platforms, participated in the Global Media Meetup held on December 12 at its headquarters in Gangnam, Seoul. Organized by AVING News, the meetup aims to bridge domestic industries with international media. It highlights innovative technologies and products from Korean companies that will be showcased at CES 2025. The event also fosters opportunities to overcome challenges in entering global markets and accelerating new business ventures.

CALIVERSE, a four-time CES exhibitor since 2022, will present its expanded hyper-realistic metaverse platform at CES 2025. The platform gained attention in August by launching its ultra-immersive metaverse, which incorporates shopping, entertainment, and gaming into its virtual ecosystem. CALIVERSE currently features two planets, New Earth and Tomorrow Planet. New Earth’s central city, Origin City, spans 4.4 million square meters—34 times the size of Lotte World in Seoul.

body.cap: An overview of Origin City | Image by CALIVERSE

body.x: Origin City offers diverse experiences, including branded spaces in the Central District, avatar fashion in the Eastern District, and user-generated content (UGC) tools in the Western District. Entertainment areas host next-generation virtual performances. Virtual flagship stores such as Korea Seven, Lotte Hi-Mart, and Lotte Duty-Free provide immersive shopping experiences, with global brands like Givenchy, Fresh, and L’Occitane available. Recently, MCM Digital House, a four-story virtual flagship store, was opened, allowing users to explore and purchase over 70 products sold by MCM.

CALIVERSE’s hallmark lies in its hyper-realistic design, blending real-world elements with futuristic aesthetics. Users can explore the vast cityscape of Origin City, enjoy immersive K-pop performances at Super Rising Arena, or participate in Tomorrow Planet’s globally renowned EDM festival, Tomorrowland. The platform’s Web3 ecosystem incorporates shopping, entertainment, and gaming, enabling economic activities and fostering user creativity. Advanced UGC tools empower users to design avatars, create virtual structures, and craft personalized quests, setting CALIVERSE apart from conventional metaverse platforms.

body.cap: DongKyu Kim presented CALIVERSE’s platform to international journalists at the Global Media Meetup. | Photo by AVING News

body.x: CALIVERSE plans to expand access by making the platform available on smartphones, mixed-reality headsets, and PCs. Future updates will also enable users to trade avatars, buildings, and land.

DongKyu Kim, CEO of CALIVERSE, highlighted the platform’s unique approach, stating, “CALIVERSE combines the freedom and creativity of platforms like Roblox and Minecraft with hyper-realistic graphics and surreal game elements reminiscent of Ready Player One. Users can create, interact, and grow qualitatively and quantitatively while earning through their creative endeavors.”

At CES 2025, held in Las Vegas from January 7 to 10, CALIVERSE will showcase its expanded metaverse world and introduce next-generation business models that blend online and offline experiences. Kim emphasized the company’s vision of enabling universal access to the metaverse without reliance on high-performance XR devices like HMDs or 3D glasses. Visitors to CES 2025 will experience CALIVERSE’s New Earth, developed in collaboration with domestic and international brands, firsthand.

body.cap: DongKyu Kim presented CALIVERSE’s platform to international journalists at the Global Media Meetup. | Photo by AVING News

body.x: AVING News, which has covered CES for 19 consecutive years, continues to bridge the gap for Korean SMEs and startups looking to expand globally. To promote Korean startups worldwide, AVING will host its Broadcasting Zone at the Venetian Expo, featuring the CES Media Day Startup Conference and global media interviews. AVING’s international media partners will cover these programs.
Following CES 2025, AVING will co-host review conferences with participating companies in Korea, offering a platform for increased visibility and improved corporate image.
